tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Look up the weather forecast for a city on a given day.

city.description: City name in English, e.g. Seoul.

day.description: One of: today, tomorrow, or an ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.description: Look up the air quality index for a city on a given day.

day.description: One of: today, tomorrow, or an ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: get_time_zone
tools.description: Look up the current local time and UTC offset of a city.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email to one recipient.

subject.description: Subject line, verbatim from the request.

body.description: Message body, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Send a text message to one phone number. Has no subject line.

phone.description: Recipient phone number, digits and dashes exactly as written.

message.description: Message text, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Create a calendar event other people can be invited to.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Set a private reminder that pings the user. Not a calendar event and not shared.

text.description: What to be reminded about, verbatim.

tools.name: lookup_order
tools.description: Look up the status of a purchase order by its id.

order_id.description: Order id exactly as written by the user.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel a purchase order by its id. Irreversible.

order_id.description: Order id exactly as written by the user.

tools.name: track_shipment
tools.description: Locate a parcel by carrier tracking number. Takes a tracking number, never an order id.

tracking_number.description: Carrier tracking number exactly as written by the user.

tools.name: convert_currency
tools.description: Convert an amount between two currencies.

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert an amount between two physical units, such as kg to lb or km to mi.

tools.name: get_stock_price
tools.description: Look up the latest share price for a ticker symbol.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol in capitals, e.g. AAPL.

tools.name: translate_text
tools.description: Translate a phrase into a target language.

target_language.description: BCP-47 code, one of: en, hi, ko.

tools.name: summarize_text
tools.description: Shorten a passage into a summary in the language it is already written in.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Full-text search over the user's own stored documents.

query.description: Search terms, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: book_flight
tools.description: Book a one-way flight between two cities on a given date.

tools.name: book_hotel
tools.description: Book a hotel room in a city for a number of nights.

tools.name: get_directions
tools.description: Get turn-by-turn driving, walking, or transit directions between two places.

origin.description: Starting address or place name, verbatim.

destination.description: Ending address or place name, verbatim.

tools.name: estimate_travel_time
tools.description: Estimate how long a trip takes without turn-by-turn directions. Not for navigation.

origin.description: Starting address or place name, verbatim.

destination.description: Ending address or place name, verbatim.

tools.name: find_nearby_places
tools.description: Find places of a category near a location, such as pharmacies or ATMs.

category.description: Place category, e.g. pharmacy, atm, cafe.

location.description: Address or neighbourhood to search around, verbatim.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres, digits only.

tools.name: get_place_details
tools.description: Look up hours, phone, and address for one place by its id. Not for searching nearby.

place_id.description: Place id exactly as written by the user.

tools.name: send_payment
tools.description: Send money to a person or merchant. Requires an amount and currency.

recipient.description: Recipient handle or account id, verbatim.

tools.name: check_payment_status
tools.description: Check whether an already-sent payment cleared. Takes a payment id, not a recipient.

payment_id.description: Payment id exactly as written by the user.

tools.name: lookup_contact
tools.description: Find a saved contact's phone or email by name.

name.description: Contact name, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: add_contact
tools.description: Save a new contact with name, phone, and email. Not for looking up an existing one.

name.description: Contact name, verbatim from the request.

phone.description: Phone number, digits and dashes exactly as written.

email.description: Email address, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a new personal note with a title and body.

title.description: Note title, verbatim from the request.

body.description: Note body, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search existing notes by keyword. Not for creating a new note.

query.description: Search terms, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: play_music
tools.description: Start playing a specific track by a named artist.

track.description: Track title, verbatim from the request.

artist.description: Artist name, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: search_music
tools.description: Search the music library by keyword. Does not start playback.

query.description: Search terms, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product to the shopping cart by its product id.

product_id.description: Product id exactly as written by the user.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the product catalogue by keyword. Does not add anything to the cart.

query.description: Search terms, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: get_news_headlines
tools.description: Fetch top headlines for a topic in a given country.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Full-text search over news articles by keyword. Not for top headlines.

query.description: Search terms, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: create_git_branch
tools.description: Create a new branch in a git repository.

repo.description: Repository name, verbatim from the request.

branch.description: New branch name, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: list_git_branches
tools.description: List existing branches in a git repository. Does not create a branch.

repo.description: Repository name, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of one file by path.

path.description: File path, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files in a directory. Does not read file contents.

directory.description: Directory path, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: log_health_metric
tools.description: Record a health measurement such as weight or blood pressure.

tools.name: get_health_summary
tools.description: Summarize logged health metrics over a period. Does not record a new reading.

tools.name: set_alarm
tools.description: Set a one-time alarm at a given time with a label.

label.description: Alarm label, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: list_alarms
tools.description: List alarms scheduled for a given date. Does not create a new alarm.

tools.name: join_video_meeting
tools.description: Join an already-scheduled video meeting by its meeting id.

meeting_id.description: Meeting id exactly as written by the user.

tools.name: schedule_video_meeting
tools.description: Schedule a new video meeting with a title, date, and time. Not for joining one.

title.description: Meeting title, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: find_restaurant
tools.description: Search for restaurants by cuisine type near a location.

location.description: Neighbourhood or address, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: reserve_restaurant
tools.description: Book a table at a specific restaurant by its id. Not for searching.

restaurant_id.description: Restaurant id exactly as written by the user.

tools.name: book_taxi
tools.description: Book a taxi pickup at a specific time between two addresses.

pickup.description: Pickup address, verbatim from the request.

dropoff.description: Drop-off address, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: estimate_taxi_fare
tools.description: Estimate the fare for a taxi trip without booking. Not for scheduling a pickup.

pickup.description: Pickup address, verbatim from the request.

dropoff.description: Drop-off address, verbatim from the request.

tools.name: track_package
tools.description: Track a parcel by its carrier reference number. Takes a reference number, not an order id or tracking number.

reference_number.description: Carrier reference number exactly as written by the user.

tools.name: lookup_delivery_status
tools.description: Check delivery status by purchase order id. Takes an order id, not a carrier reference.

order_id.description: Order id exactly as written by the user.
